key_insight: PoetryQwen uses a domain-specific instruction dataset and LoRA fine-tuning to improve classical Chinese poetry translation and affective-semantic understanding.
engineering_relevance: The paper shows that targeted dataset construction plus lightweight adaptation can outperform a strong general LLM baseline on a specialized evaluation task.
method: Built CCPoetry-49K with 49,404 cleaned and aligned instruction-response pairs
Split the task into term interpretation, semantic interpretation, and emotional inference
LoRA-fine-tuned Qwen2.5-14B to create the domain-specialized PoetryQwen model
evidence_signal: On CCL25-Eval Task 5, PoetryQwen scored 0.757 versus 0.690 for Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, a 9.7% improvement.
watch_item: The reported gains are benchmark-specific, so broader generalization to other classical Chinese texts or unseen poetic styles still needs validation.
paper_title: System Report for CCL25-Eval Task 5: New Dataset and LoRA-Fine-Tuned Qwen2.5
